# lecture III - Feb 23 2026 - revision

The so-called Fredkin gate is an example of a controlled 2-Qbit Unitary, i.e., its
control determines whether or not the two targets are affected.
Specifically, only if the control is in state $|1\rangle$, the target Qbits are swapped.

- Which matrix might represent the Fredkin gate in the computational basis?
- Assemble a circuit using Toffoli gates, only.
- Decompose the Fredkin gate into a sequence of 2-level unitaries.
- Of this latter decomposition, pick one Unitary and give two circuit realizations
which differ in the wire/Qbit on which a non-trivial operation is applied.

**(reading: Nielsen and Chuang, section 4.1 and 4.2, and 4.3)**
